tools.name: get_explainer_video
tools.description: Get GitDiagram's narrated explainer video of a public GitHub repository, if one has been made: the link to watch and share it, its title and length, and the full narration transcript, a plain-language walkthrough of what the project is for, what people do with it and how its main parts fit together.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_repository_diagram, get_explainer_video · Private data: find_repository_diagrams · Public sink: get_explainer_video.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_repository_diagram, get_explainer_video · Private data: find_repository_diagrams · Public sink: get_explainer_video

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
